cases.name: fixtures
cases.detail: One repository with all four states plus an exact created_at tie, a 30-row repository, and foreign-repository jobs

cases.name: detail
cases.detail: Detail returns durable identity/progress/result/error/timestamps without lease capabilities; foreign and unknown ids are 404

cases.name: pagination
cases.detail: Pages of every size reproduce one newest-first order including an exact timestamp tie; state filter, 25/100 bounds and repository-scoped cursors hold

cases.name: rejected_queries
cases.detail: Malformed, duplicate, unknown, out-of-range and non-canonical cursor queries are rejected before any read

cases.name: access
cases.detail: Owner read-only tokens are 403, read/triage/write collaborators are 403, maintain/admin can read, unauthorized private access stays 404

limitations: Keyset pages are live views, not snapshots across requests.
The scheduler case covers one native push on a loopback server; it is not a throughput or multi-node qualification.
No index is added for the newest-first ordering, so planner choice is not fixed.
